Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. By means of the instant bail application, the applicant, Keshav Alias Shashi Prakash, seeks bail in Case Crime No. 120 of 2024, under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station Gandhi Park, District Aligarh.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is named in the F.I.R.

The allegation against the applicant is that he had taken loan of twenty lakh rupees by mortgaging the property and thereafter he sold some part of the said property to the two other co-accused, who are also named in the F.I.R.
Learned counsel further submits that on the mortgaged property the applicant had constructed several shops and sell out those shops, hence no offence is made out.

sentences.text: alleged by the prosecution is false and fabricated.

The applicant was paying regular installments but due to Covid-19 pandemic the applicant could not paid the remaining loan amount within time and in pursuance of the same without issuing any notice to the applicant the company had lodged the F.I.R. with malafide intention and ulterior motive.
The applicant is still ready to pay the entire loan amount to the company.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 06.12.2024.

4. Learned A.G.A. for the State has opposed the prayer for bail prayer by contending that the applicant had taken loan from the company by mortgaging his property in the year 2022, whereas he had sold the some part of property in the year 2019, therefore, the applicant does not deserve any indulgence.

5. Keeping in view submissions of learned counsel for the parties, gravity of offence, nature of allegations and all the attending facts and circumstances of the case and considering the fact that he had sold out the mortgaged property, therefore, the present bail deserves to be rejected.
6. Accordingly, the bail application of applicant-Keshav Alias Shashi Prakash, is rejected.

Order Date :- 8.8.2025 Mustaqeem.
